name: Breakout Surge
description: Stocks closing above their 20-day high on an up day — exiting consolidation with participation behind the move.
tooltip: Match: close above the highest close of the prior 20 sessions + green day + price ≥ ₹50. NSE + BSE combined (NSE preferred for dual listings) — use the exchange tabs or MCap filter to narrow. Ranked by Score 5D (money-flow conviction).

name: Flower Pot Burst
description: Stocks coiling in tight compression — dying volume, contracting range — plus the rare session when a coil releases with an explosive volume-and-range expansion
tooltip: Energy compression then release. Watchlist = coiling setups; Burst = a coil that just released today. Observational — not a trade instruction.

name: Weekly Movers
description: NSE stocks trading above last week's close — ranked by week-to-date gain
tooltip: Stocks whose current price is above the previous week's closing price, ranked by how far the week has travelled so far. Observational only; not a recommendation.

name: Monthly Movers
description: NSE stocks trading above last month's close — ranked by month-to-date gain
tooltip: Observational only; not a recommendation.

name: Breakdown Surge
description: NSE stocks closing below their 20-day low on a red day — ranked by depth below the level
tooltip: The exact mirror of Breakout Surge. Observational only; not a recommendation.

name: Weekly Decliners
description: NSE stocks trading below last week's close — ranked by week-to-date loss
tooltip: Stocks whose current price is below the previous week's closing price, ranked by how far the week has fallen so far. The mirror of Weekly Movers. This is week-to-date weakness, not a breakdown through a level: a stock can appear here while still holding its 20-day floor, and while closing green today. Observational only; not a recommendation.

name: Monthly Decliners
description: NSE stocks trading below last month's close — ranked by month-to-date loss
tooltip: Observational only; not a recommendation.

name: Golden Line Breakout
description: Stocks closing back above the 150-day Golden Line on a volume-drive or accumulation bar
tooltip: The close crossed from at-or-below the Golden Line (150-bar mean close) to above it, on a session printing SVD or SBD. The volume signature lands on the crossing bar itself, so the reclaim carries evidence rather than being a drift across the line. Observational conditions, not a recommendation.

name: Golden Line Retest
description: Stocks that came back to the Golden Line and held it on a volume-drive or accumulation bar
tooltip: Observational conditions, not a recommendation.

name: Stage 2 Watch
description: Stocks knocking on the Stage 2 door — moving averages stacked in order, waiting only for the long-term average to turn up.
tooltip: Match: Stage 2 candidate — MA stacking confirmed (price > 50-day > 150-day > 200-day), 200-day average not yet rising. Ranked by RS percentile.

name: Stage 2 Leaders
description: Stocks in a confirmed Weinstein Stage 2 advance — the phase where trends are established and orderly.
tooltip: Match: classified Stage 2 — price above rising long-term averages with proper 52-week position. Ranked by Relative Strength.

name: Stage 3 Watch
description: Previously trending stocks entering the topping phase — momentum flattening as the long-term averages converge.
tooltip: Ranked weakest-first by RS percentile.

name: Stage 4 Leaders
description: Stocks in a confirmed Stage 4 decline — an observation list for risk awareness, not a trade list.
tooltip: Ranked weakest-first by RS percentile.

name: VaNi Weakness Watch
description: VaNi's shortlist of the weakest names — confirmed Stage 4 with the lowest relative strength. For exit timing and risk review.
tooltip: Bottom 25 by RS percentile.

name: Conviction Flow
description: Stocks where this week's delivery money is running well ahead of its monthly norm — buying with intent, still near a sensible re-entry zone.
tooltip: Match: 5-day avg delivery value above 1.5× the 22-day avg + 22-day avg above ₹1.5 Cr + price within ±8% of its 20-day average. Ranked by delivery surge multiple.

name: Strength Confluence
description: Stocks where several independent positive conditions line up at once, inside industries that money is currently favouring.
tooltip: Universe: industries leading or rotating in. Match: a Rising-Flow Signature, OR price above its 150-day average + a Leading/Improving Relative Strength zone + fresh-longs / short-covering flow + volume above 1.5× normal. Top 25 by Relative Strength.

name: Volume Drive
description: Stocks printing a volume-drive or accumulation bar — ranked by delivery conviction
tooltip: Surfaces continuation, not prediction.

name: Smart Money Loading
description: Stocks moving into strong hands — high delivery (shares actually taken home, not day-traded) inside industries where inflow is broad.
tooltip: Universe: industries with over 60% of members in rising flow. Match: delivery above 60% of traded quantity + positive RSS momentum. Top 25 by delivery %.

name: Weakness Confluence
description: Stocks where several independent weakening conditions coincide, inside industries currently losing participation.
tooltip: Bottom 25 by Relative Strength.

name: Quiet Rising Flow
description: Under-the-radar industries where inflow is rising before the price story is obvious.
tooltip: Top 25 by industry flow change.

name: Falling Flow Warnings
description: Recently strong stocks showing early signs that large holders may be handing off. A risk-review list.
tooltip: Ranked by size of the strength slip × industry rank drop.

name: Waking Giants
description: Long-listed companies that fell hard from an old peak - shown only when quiet delivery-backed building appears
tooltip: Companies with 10+ years of listed history that at some point fell at least half from a 3-year high set over a year ago and have not fully recovered. A name appears ONLY when evidence shows quiet delivery-backed building. Observational conditions, not a recommendation.

name: Ascent
description: Confirmed multi-year journeys in progress - aligned across the daily, weekly and monthly clocks
tooltip: Observational conditions, not a recommendation.

name: Stirring
description: Quiet delivery-backed building inside a multi-year hibernation - no breakout yet
tooltip: Observational, not a recommendation.
